about: The answers of the ctx MCP tools store, get and search that the ctx_checkpoint plugin parses (memory/mcp_client.py).
One source for both sides: go/internal/handler/mcp_checkpoint_answers_integration_test.go drives the real MCP handlers
with the write below and compares their answers with this file; memory/tests/test_mcp_answer_contract.py and
tests/test_paced_idempotent_chain.py feed exactly these answers to the plugin. A change on either side turns the other red.
Placeholders in the store templates: {title}, {id}, {category}. Hermes hands every MCP text result to the plugin as
search.types is what the head lookup sends (GottZ/ctx#342); search.types_refused is the error a ctx server before
#342 answers to it (Hermes hands an error to the plugin as {"error": "<text>"}). The query tool still answers that
text to the same types, which the ctx side checks, so the wording the plugin falls back on is the server's own.

store.no_change: No change needed — identical content already exists (id: {id})

about: The untrusted_origin record (GottZ/ctx#280, #295): a block re-typed out of a type marked untrusted names that type.
The ctx side writes the block below over MCP store, re-types it over MCP update and checks that get and search carry
the field; it renders query.answer and retrieval.answer (the /api/query answers) through the real MCP query tool and
compares the text with query.text and retrieval.text, and checks note against store.UntrustedOriginNote. The plugin
parses exactly these texts (memory/tests/test_untrusted_origin.py). Placeholder in note: {origin}.
